Polybius Square Tool

Convert letters to Polybius square coordinates (5×5 grid, I/J merged) and decode coordinates back.

I and J share cell 24. Coordinates read row-first, then column.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter text (letters) or coordinate pairs.
  2. Choose Encode or Decode.
  3. Press Run.
  4. Copy the result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the Polybius square work?

Letters sit in a 5×5 grid; each becomes its row+column number (A=11, B=12 … Z=55). I and J share a cell.

How do I decode?

Type them as digit pairs like 111213, optionally separated by spaces — J decodes as I/J.

Is it row-then-column?

Coordinates are read row-first then column-first in the classic layout.
